author: imwoozy
quote:
Hats off to however created extremely complex NPC AI behavioural tree. It's genuinely the best I've seen in a video game. However, the story and the whole lecturing on "how to be a good man" is annoying and boring. With a main protagonist Jason having 0 character and identity. Filled with boring realistic chores. Realism does not equal fun. Absence of 60 FPS performance mode is a greedy strategy to sell more copies in future. 
GTA franchise was always about the freedom and it is heart-breaking to see we are being taken away a lot of mechanics that existed throughout the series due to "moral" reasons. Such as plane crashes absence, inability to highjack any car from the beginning, social groups that are protected from violence, no street workers, inability to make a shootout in a club etc.
